purpose: Teach: 大木/所沢/野原/大輔/中西/大津/大平/大江

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが裏山の大木を御自ら植えられた
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he planted that big tree on the back hill himself.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Gentle tempo, almost dreamlike. Slight pause between clauses, as if watching the scene unfold. Voice trails upward slightly at the end, tenderly uncertain.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、所沢の航空基地で勤務されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—and your grandfather, when he was young, he worked at the Tokorozawa air base, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, present voice with a gentle corrective lilt. Not argumentative, just redirecting—the patient way a long marriage knows how. Soft smile at the end on 'dear,' almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが野原の上の星空を眺められた
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he used to gaze up at the stars above the open field.
lines.style: The same wistful register but with quieter wonder. Slower still. Almost breathing the image out. Voice softens further on 'stars'—almost reverent.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、息子様の大輔さんと釣りに行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather, when he was young, he went fishing with your son Daisuke, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle persistence. The rhythm of someone who has done this dance many times—loving but insistent. Pride in the mention of 'Daisuke.' Warm close on the familiar 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが中西氏と同じ職場で働かれた
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he worked alongside Nakanishi at the same company.
lines.style: Returning to the wistful mode but with a shift toward specificity—less dreamlike, more anchored to fact. Steady, grounded. Voice settles on the names.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、大津の祭礼に毎年参加されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather, when he was young, he attended the Otsu festival every single year, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: The same gentle redirection, but now with warmth at the ritual itself. Slight emphasis on 'every year'—pride in the consistency. Close voice, intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「大平正芳総理を尊敬」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he once said he deeply respected Prime Minister Ohira Masayoshi.
lines.style: A shift in tone—more formal now, more precise. Voice lifts slightly on the phrase about respect, as if quoting something sacred. Deliberate pacing. Reverent close.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、大江健三郎の小説を蔵書されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather, when he was young, he collected Oe Kenzaburo's novels, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Close, intimate, knowing voice. The tone of someone who has heard this story and loves it. Warm smile on 'Oe Kenzaburo'—the name itself is an affection. Tender fadeout on 'dear,' almost a whisper.
